_note: capture_fps = real recording rate of the phone's slow-motion mode (the file itself is saved at ~30 fps for playback). Full-HD originals copied from Google Drive. role: 'fit' clips are used to fit the parameters, 'test' clips are never seen by the fit. use_trajectory=false: clip used for the wobble targets only, not the trajectory fit.

clip3._why: extreme fold: the sponge folds onto itself, which the model cannot represent (no self-contact), and the simulation becomes chaotic there. Its free wobble is still used (stage A); its trajectories are reported as a stress test.
